sections.heading: Is online therapy right for your stress and life transitions?
paragraphs: Carrying heavy stress or going through a major life change can leave you feeling drained, anxious, or stuck. Many Black women and other adults in Tennessee carry the weight of professional demands, family expectations, and community care without taking time for themselves. Burnout and anxiety do not always look dramatic. Sometimes they show up as persistent exhaustion, trouble sleeping, constant worry, or feeling disconnected from the people you love. Therapy provides a structured space to untangle these feelings.

Relationship strain and sudden life transitions can also make daily routines feel overwhelming. Whether you are adjusting to a new career phase, navigating family shifts, or simply trying to catch your breath, having an objective, trained professional to talk to makes a difference. Hicks Consulting offers dedicated virtual spaces to help you explore these exact challenges. sections.heading: What is the difference between therapy, coaching, and support groups?
paragraphs: Deciding which service fits your needs depends on your current goals and what kind of support you are looking for. Therapy is a clinical service focused on mental health, emotional healing, and working through deep-seated patterns of anxiety, stress, or trauma. It is designed for adults in Tennessee who want a clinical professional to help them understand and manage emotional health challenges. Therapy never involves medical, legal, or financial advice, and it does not promise specific outcomes.

Coaching is a non-clinical service that is not therapy. Coaching focuses on practical goal setting, personal growth, accountability, and navigating specific current circumstances rather than clinical mental health treatment. Support groups offer a community setting where adults facing similar life transitions or stressors can share experiences and gain mutual encouragement in a guided format. Hicks Consulting provides these distinct options virtually so you can choose the format that aligns best with your personal goals.

For employers and organizations looking to support their teams, organizational mental health training and speaking are also available. This helps build healthier workplace environments and reduces stigma around mental health challenges in professional settings.
